parts.text: Being busy is a form of laziness.
You answer every message. You clean your desk. You reorganize your to-do list.
And by the end of the day, you're exhausted.
But you never touched the one task that actually mattered.
Because busy work is easy. It feels productive, and it never scares you.
So you hide in small tasks, and call it hard work.
Here's the fix: tomorrow morning, before you open a single message, do the one thing you've been avoiding.
Busy is easy. Important is hard.
